paragraphs.text: Karli of the Singing Moon was one of the wizards Towser 's army of wizards. She lived on Aerona , part of the Domains of Dominaria .

Karli was a desert wizard . She was short and delicate, with almost black mahogany skin, shining black eyes, and white hair. She wore a heavily brocaded jacket and long, thick pants, with a cape of fine yellow feathers. Her jacket was lined down the lapels and around the middle with a myriad of buttons and medallions that served as her grimoire. She wore bright pink slippers, so curled that the toes folded onto themselves, that sported tiny wings and allowed her to fly. She spoke multiple languages.

In the early winter of 4074 AR , Karli attacked the army of Gull and Greensleeves with a tornado and an army of summoned erg raiders and flying men . She joined Towser 's army of wizards as the only other who was not bound by the Stone Brain . She participated in the Battle of Lat-Nam , but was on the losing side, and ended up swearing allegiance and loyalty to Greensleeves to save her magic from being drained completely.
